claims.quote: current approaches do not monitor whether the live process of information gathering is functioning properly. Consequently, such systems can remain operationally active without resolving outstanding mission requirements.

This monitor emits two continuous real time signals that quantify (i) prospective progress across unresolved requirements and (ii) informational friction generated when recurrent evidence yields negilible informational gain.
We evaluated a single, unadjusted monitor configuration across eight diverse domains
the friction channel distinguished unproductive stagnation from purposeful exploration prior to task completion, while remaining muted during post completion activity
